case_fastener: 4 x ISO4762/DIN912 M3x12 socket head,2.5mm hex
internal_support_method: Continuous chamfers; no fins, combs or support blockers
joystick_mounting: Not integrated: pending carrier and PCB mounting-hole qualification. Rear reference is preserved; do not fabricate as a complete joystick enclosure.
assemblySequence: Front face down on soft surface
Insert LCD against face ledge; slide upper/lower keepers and tighten two M2 locks
Place the loose button caps in the front face; keep face down until PCB is secured.
Insert joystick modules; fasten actual ears to front posts with four M1.4 screws; connect ribbons
Fit PCB onto front bosses and fasten four M3 × 6 screws from rear
Mount battery holder to rear shell using retained clips; connect battery; close with four M3 × 12 screws
limitations: Joystick detailing uses related drawing, not exact purchased variant CAD.
Flex curves show routing intent; actual length, contact side and bend limits require physical verification.
Nominal ear support posts, M1.4 insert bores, button motion and LCD glass load require prototype fit.
Retained PCB is unchanged; collision checks are review evidence, not complete manufacturing acceptance.
Four M1.4 × 4 screws and Ø2.2 × 2.5 insert envelopes are proposed, not sourced production hardware.
PCB inserts 1 and 2 removed by request. Their screws and posts remain; these two screw locations have no qualified threaded anchorage.
